purpose: One-time generalization test of two already-frozen Native Quant rules on two executability-selected markets whose strategy performance has never been viewed.

frozenRules.name: CONF-RSI14-WILLR14-30/70+EMA400
frozenRules.longEntryOnCompletedBar: RSI14 < 30 and Williams %R14 < -80 and close > EMA400
frozenRules.shortEntryOnCompletedBar: RSI14 > 70 and Williams %R14 > -20 and close < EMA400

frozenRules.name: CONF-VWZ60-2.5+MFI14-35/65+EMA400
frozenRules.longEntryOnCompletedBar: VWAP60 z-score < -2.5 and MFI14 < 35 and close > EMA400
frozenRules.shortEntryOnCompletedBar: VWAP60 z-score > 2.5 and MFI14 > 65 and close < EMA400

executionContract.entry: next bar open after a completed-bar signal
executionContract.indicatorExit: next bar open after a completed-bar exit signal
executionContract.stop: intrabar at the frozen 1% stop price

funding.method: exact Lighter hourly settlements during each position

individualMarketGate.trendRegimes: bull and bear each N >= 20, net > 0, PF >= 1.10; mixed must pass the same net/PF gate when N >= 20
individualMarketGate.volatilityRegimes: high and low volatility each N >= 20, net > 0, PF >= 1.10
individualMarketGate.recentWindows: 30d, 60d and 90d each N >= 20, net > 0, PF >= 1.10 and both Long/Short net > 0

transferDecision.pass: A rule/timeframe transfers only if both SPX and BERA independently pass every individualMarketGate condition. A result on only one market is rejected as non-generalizing. 1m and 5m are evaluated as separately preregistered hypotheses.
transferDecision.multipleTestingControl: No best-cell selection: a transferable candidate requires the same frozen rule and timeframe to pass on both reserved markets.
transferDecision.onPass: Require runtime-parity verification, then register only a fresh zero-history prospective Shadow strategy. Real remains disabled until the normal frozen forward gate passes.
transferDecision.onFailure: Reject the rule/timeframe transfer. Do not tune thresholds, holding time, stop, symbols, costs, period or market subset on this spent holdout.
